name: water-works
description: The liquid layer end to end on one seed: hand-farms the field through three Chip Kitchens for the money, researches Hydraulics to the Irrigation Hub, drops a Pump on the pond bank, drag-routes one seventeen-tile pipe run around two sides of the field and a second one it tears straight back up, and hangs a Tank, two piped sprinkler heads and a Hub off the survivor — deliberately more demand than one pump can meet, so the round-robin throttle, the tank buffer, the reservoir draw and the Hub’s rotating dry-tile scan all run under load for 4,000 ticks. Pins the one-ledger flow model and the geometric network ids.
